title: Finite free refinement of a strictly perfect local representative
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], $U\subseteq X$ open, and $P$ a strictly perfect complex on $U$ [def-pc-perfect-complex] with $E|_U\cong Q(P)$. For every $x\in U$ there is an affine open $V$ with $x\in V\subseteq U$ and a bounded complex $F$ of finite free $\mathcal O_V$-modules with $E|_V\cong Q(F)$. The finite rank can depend on the degree.

source.place: Definitions 08C4 and 08CM; algebra.tex Tag 00NX (3) implies (7); schemes.tex Tags 01IA and 01IB

proof.text: Choose an affine neighbourhood W of x inside U and restrict P and its termwise finite free splittings to W. The restricted term is the image of an idempotent on a finite free sheaf. On W, tilde-Gamma identifies the idempotent with its matrix of global sections. Splitting this matrix in modules and applying tilde identifies the term with the sheaf of a finite projective module. Restriction preserves the bounds and zero terms.

Apply the finite projective standard free cover to each of the finitely many terms inside the bounds. Choose a principal open containing x for each term. Their finite intersection is an affine neighbourhood V of x inside U. Restrict P and its differential termwise to V to obtain F. Every term inside the bounds is free of finite rank by the chosen trivializations; every other term is zero, hence free of rank zero. This also covers an empty degree interval.

Restrict the given derived isomorphism to V. Exact-functor localization (mapDerivedCategoryFactors) identifies restriction of Q(P) with Q(F). The nested-open comparison overFunctorMap, transported by mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso, identifies the other endpoint with E restricted directly to V. Composing gives E|V isomorphic to Q(F).

theorem exists_finiteFree_refinement_of_isStrictlyPerfect
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (U : X.Opens)
    (P : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hP : IsStrictlyPerfect X U P)
    (hEP : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ V ≤ U ∧ IsAffine V.toScheme ∧
      ∃ F : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V)) ℤ,
        (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (F.X n)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (F.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) ∧
        Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) V).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj F)
